where_used: Lime on all Core 5; lemon in Chicken 65 marinade; tamarind glaze; vinegar in adobo; pickled onion; NA lime and tamarind drinks
cross_utilization_opportunity: Lime and tamarind serve food and NA drinks; one pickle base for tacos and boards
identity_tension: Using one generic sour for everything would flatten the separate Indian and Mexican acids
spoilage_or_waste_note: Cut citrus dulls fast; pickles hold longer; tamarind keeps well
backup_idea: Another firm citrus; tamarind pulp from block
question_for_testing: Does a shared acid still read distinct on each dish and in each NA drink?

where_used: Green chile in Chicken 65 and salsa; guajillo and ancho in birria and gobi glaze; poblano in quesadilla; red chilli in the spice set
cross_utilization_opportunity: Guajillo serves birria adobo and gobi glaze; fresh green chile serves Chicken 65 and salsa
identity_tension: Indian and Mexican chiles are not interchangeable; swapping for one chile would erase the cues
spoilage_or_waste_note: Dried pods go stale; fresh chiles soften; poblano is seasonal
backup_idea: Reputable grocer pods; frozen roasted poblano (untested)
question_for_testing: Can one dried chile serve both birria and the gobi glaze without either tasting generic?

where_used: Cilantro, curry leaf, onion, ginger, garlic across all Core 5; green herb in NA drinks
cross_utilization_opportunity: Cilantro and onion serve tacos, salsa and garnish; ginger-garlic serves several marinades
identity_tension: Curry leaf is the Chicken 65 identity cue and has no cilantro substitute
spoilage_or_waste_note: Curry leaf browns fast and local supply is unknown; cilantro wilts
backup_idea: Frozen curry leaf; dried leaf is a weak option
question_for_testing: How much curry leaf and cilantro is wasted per service, and does the dish survive without fresh curry leaf?

where_used: Yogurt in marinades; crema in Chicken 65; paneer taco; melting cheese in quesadilla; butter or ghee in makhani; lassi-style NA drink
cross_utilization_opportunity: One yogurt for marinades and a lassi-style drink; crema and yogurt may overlap
identity_tension: Crema is Mexican and raita-style yogurt is Indian; merging them blurs both
spoilage_or_waste_note: Short life; paneer firms; cheese rennet and gelatin sources need label checks (D-54)
backup_idea: Strained yogurt; sour cream thinned with lime; quesillo
question_for_testing: Can crema and yogurt share stock without guests noticing a loss of either identity?

where_used: Totopos for Chicken 65; corn tortillas for three tacos; quesadilla tortilla (corn or flour, open)
cross_utilization_opportunity: One tortilla supply can feed totopos and tacos
identity_tension: A flour-corn blend or lard-containing tortilla breaks both identity and D-54
spoilage_or_waste_note: Stale tortillas tear; single source is a supply risk
backup_idea: Fresh masa pressed in house (needs equipment and professional)
question_for_testing: Does one tortilla spec work for chip frying, tacos and the comal, or must they differ?

where_used: Chicken 65, chips, possible gobi fry arm
cross_utilization_opportunity: One neutral oil for all frying
identity_tension: Shared oil can blur flavours and mix vegetarian and meat cross-contact
spoilage_or_waste_note: Oil breaks down with use; discard timing unknown
question_for_testing: Is a separate vegetarian fry path needed, and what does it do to the fryer count?

where_used: Indian spice set in marinades, makhani, birria layer and glaze; chaat masala; kasuri methi
cross_utilization_opportunity: Shared whole spices ground in house across dishes
identity_tension: One house masa-la for everything would make all five taste alike
spoilage_or_waste_note: Ground spices lose potency; blends may hide additives
question_for_testing: Can two or three blends cover the five dishes while each stays distinct?

where_used: Lime, onion, cilantro, pickled onion, slaw, salsa on the Core 5; garnish on NA drinks
cross_utilization_opportunity: Same lime, onion and herb mise for food and bar
identity_tension: A common garnish tray makes dishes look alike; the NA garnish draws on the same prep
spoilage_or_waste_note: Cut garnish wilts and is discarded daily
backup_idea: Fewer garnish types with distinct cuts
question_for_testing: Which garnishes can be shared without losing each dish look and who preps the bar garnish?

where_used: Chicken thigh in Chicken 65 and quesadilla; bone-in goat in birria
cross_utilization_opportunity: One chicken thigh supply; goat bones and trim could feed goat stock
identity_tension: Goat must read as goat; chicken stock is allowed but must not replace the goat identity
spoilage_or_waste_note: Raw poultry and goat are high risk; goat yield and supply unknown; no beef or pork cross-contact (D-54)
backup_idea: Lamb passed as goat is not acceptable; bone-in leg is
question_for_testing: What does goat cost in trim and loss, and can stock use goat bones only?

where_used: Cauliflower, poblano, cabbage slaw, onion, tomato, fruit for NA
cross_utilization_opportunity: Cabbage and onion cross tacos and garnish
identity_tension: Seasonal substitutes could weaken the gobi or poblano cues
spoilage_or_waste_note: Cauliflower and poblano are seasonal; slaw wilts
backup_idea: Frozen florets or roasted poblano (both untested)
question_for_testing: How much produce is lost to trim and softening when the mix shifts toward vegetarian dishes?

where_used: Fruit and lime; spiced citrus and botanicals; tea with tamarind or hibiscus; saline lime; lassi-style cultured dairy
cross_utilization_opportunity: Lime, tamarind and herbs overlap kitchen supply; tea and spice infusions could batch
identity_tension: Efficiency pulls toward fewer drinks, but each NA pairing is tied to one dish and a shared drink may fit none well
spoilage_or_waste_note: Fresh juice and cultured dairy need food-safety review; infusions have short hold
backup_idea: Concentrates are a fallback only if a professional approves them
question_for_testing: Can fewer NA drinks cover the Core 5, or does each dish need its own?
